name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) hard matches 'each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off'. siren_ringing lasts until the switch is toggled, and a toggle never coincides with siren_ringing, so the clause makes each ring owe one later toggle, with no ChainResponse timing added.

texts: Each time the siren rings (siren_ringing holds), the agent toggles the siren switch at that step or later, ending every ring.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
